Native C remains an additional vec2+mat2+mat2d smoke contract, not part of the JavaScript compatibility claim.

Alternate gzip-9 and Brotli-11 sizes are always reported because optimizing one codec is not a promise about another. Partial, adapter-algorithm, and subset implementations are implementation backlog only and are not published as library comparisons. C/native checks are additional portability evidence where the selected API can be represented natively, not a substitute for JavaScript compatibility.
